description: Are a token's early buyers independent or one operator? Follows each early buyer's first funding (up to 2 hops): clusters sharing a funder (exchange hubs excluded), dev-linked and fresh wallets, launch-block bundles, split supply, supply bought and still held, coordination risk %. tier=max: 60 buyers, 2 hops, the creator's other launches and insider rings vs sniper bots. Works for pump.fun tokens (Solana) and Base tokens (0x...). Price: standard $0.04, max $0.20. 5-60 s. Paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Polygon or Solana) per call; failed or empty calls are never charged.
